axes.behavior: Nineteen direct implementer callbacks delegate to a proxy getter, cast the result and invoke Consumer.accept once; finite property renderer/model outputs only.
axes.costs: Not applicable: no mana, cast, durability settlement or gameplay cooldown in the selected callback/property methods. Object allocations and model baking are presentation work, not certified gameplay costs.
axes.identity: Publisher 1.0.10 SHA-1/SHA-256/size; Java21 class identity, one abstract erased Consumer ABI and generic IClientItemExtensions declaration.
axes.integration: Static callback declarations and finite CommonProxy/ClientProxy and relocated Citadel property outputs; zero publisher initializeClient member references. External engine dispatch, proxy selection, registration execution and perks are unverified.
axes.parameters: Twelve native item-render callbacks, six native armor callbacks and one relocated Citadel callback; exact operands, property/renderer lifetimes, six model selection branches and supplied fallback.
axes.targeting: Not applicable: these selected methods configure client presentation and model selection; no target query, damage request, projectile or gameplay effect application is present.
axes.validation: Typed 1555-class census, member-reference/declaration separation, complete selected bodies and hashes, explicit pivots, negative checks and deterministic exact-JAR CLI reproduction; physical client execution is NOT_TESTED.

extension_outputs.armor_animation_boundary: Null entity returns supplied selected model. Primordial/Hazmat/Darkness model instances invoke corresponding withAnimations; other models pass through. Those model bodies and rendering internals are excluded.
extension_outputs.armor_initialization: getACArmorModelBase calls initializeModels only while init is false; initializeModels sets mutable static init=true before six Minecraft layer bakes/model allocations. No exception handlers; runtime bake success and recovery are not established.
extension_outputs.armor_model_selection: getHumanoidArmorModel ignores EquipmentSlot, passes entity/stack/supplied model to getACArmorModel, casts result to HumanoidModel; six ordered instanceof item branches return mutable public static model fields; unmatched stack returns supplied fallback model.
extension_outputs.citadel_properties_lifetime: CitadelClientProxy.getISTERProperties creates fresh CitadelItemRenderProperties each call; its constructor stores one private final CitadelItemstackRenderer and getCustomRenderer returns that renderer.
extension_outputs.common_proxy_returns: CommonProxy both getters and CitadelProxy.getISTERProperties return null; a successful client proxy selection or non-null registration is not inferred.
extension_outputs.native_item_renderer_lifetime: ACItemRenderProperties.getCustomRenderer creates a fresh ACItemstackRenderer on every call; no renderer cache is declared in this properties class.
extension_outputs.native_properties_lifetime: ClientProxy constructor creates one ACItemRenderProperties and one ACArmorRenderProperties, stores private final fields; getters return those fields per proxy instance.

registration_boundary.absence_scope: Zero typed Methodref/InterfaceMethodref calls named initializeClient in this exact publisher JAR; this does not prove runtime non-use, because external engine dispatch, reflection or external consumers may invoke declarations.
registration_boundary.excluded: External Minecraft/NeoForge Item and IClientItemExtensions engine bodies, runtime event registration, reflective calls, renderer CFG, layer/model/withAnimations internals, resource-pack rendering, active equipment powers, gameplay authorization, mutating hooks, perks and physical client execution.
registration_boundary.independent_model_property_events: ClientProxy model-property registration is an independent presentation surface, not evidence of an ACClientExtensionItem dispatcher.

assignability_census.scope: Publisher class parent/interface graph only; external subclasses and runtime loading are not enumerated.

typed_reference_census.member_reference_scope: Every Methodref and InterfaceMethodref named initializeClient, any owner and any descriptor; includes references reachable by method handles but does not infer reflective/external calls
typed_reference_census.method: CLASS/Fieldref/Methodref/InterfaceMethodref/NameAndType/MethodType plus declared JVM descriptors; UTF8/String names alone do not count

validation.authority: SHA-exact publisher binary; no adjacent source is used for installed behavior.
validation.reproduction: Mandatory seal comparison; deterministic full selected method rows/code hashes, typed census and explicit pivots; negative mutation checks and twice-run physical-binary CLI idempotence.
